display_name: Cyberpunk 2077 built-in benchmark (assisted: you start it from the menu)
warning: Cyberpunk 2077 starts through Steam. When its main menu shows, start the built-in benchmark yourself (Settings, then Run Benchmark); the app waits up to 15 minutes for the result file and then closes the game. Do not use the computer otherwise meanwhile.
notes: NOT VERIFIED. Running the game was not allowed while the user was away (2026-10-18), so the menu keys, the result folder and the JSON keys (Data.averageFps / minFps / maxFps) are assumptions from public descriptions of the game's benchmark. No keys are sent: the user starts the benchmark. If the file or its keys differ, the run is 'invalid' (never a 0) and the file is copied to the run folder to fix this script. Frame times by PresentMon are a separate capture (Frame capture tab).
